title: The Silent Crash
narration: September nineteen fifty-nine. A spacecraft slammed into the Moon. No explosion. No sound. Just silence. Luna two—the first human object to reach another world—crashed September fourteen, signal ceasing on impact. The Moon has no atmosphere to carry sound. That silence rewrote history.
visual_goal: Dramatic silent lunar impact; probe hitting regolith, kicking dust in eerie vacuum.

title: A Giant Leap for Mankind
narration: Ten years later, Apollo eleven launched, reaching lunar orbit in about three days. On July twenty, nineteen sixty-nine, Neil Armstrong walked. Twelve humans have left footprints—none since. Fewer than ISS visitors. Why never returned?
visual_goal: Apollo 11 launch, Earth receding, first footprint in regolith.

title: The Silent Sentry
narration: The Moon has been Earth's quiet partner for about four point five billion years. Orbits at three hundred eighty-four thousand four hundred kilometers, pulling tides. But what if born from catastrophe? Answer is in three hundred eighty-two kilograms of lunar rock—unexpected.
visual_goal: Time-lapse Moon orbiting Earth, tidal bulges; transition to nebula.

title: Born from Chaos
narration: Samples told a violent story. Leading hypothesis: a Mars-sized body smashed into early Earth, and the debris that escaped its gravity slowly coalesced into the Moon. A hypothesis, but the leading one.
visual_goal: Giant-impact animation: protoplanets colliding, debris ring forming Moon.

title: A Frozen Face
narration: We always see the same face. Moon rotates every twenty-seven point three two days, matching orbit. Synchronous lock hides one hemisphere. That fixed stare masks violent extremes.
visual_goal: Rotating Moon showing near side, far side as dark mystery.

title: Extreme Silence
narration: At lunar noon, temperature reaches one hundred twenty-seven degrees Celsius—hotter than boiling water. After sunset, -one hundred seventy-three degrees Celsius—colder than Antarctica. No air, wind, or sound. Boiling to freezing.
visual_goal: Split-screen scorching lunar day, fading to frozen night with sharp stars.

title: A Lighter Step
narration: Gravity is one sixth of Earth's. A one hundred-kilograms person would feel about sixteen point seven kilograms. Jump three times higher effortlessly. Escape velocity: two point four kilometers per second.
visual_goal: Astronauts bounding in slow motion, high jumps, floating dust, Earth backdrop.

title: A Heavy Heart
narration: Moon holds about seven point three times ten to the twenty-two kilograms of rock over one thousand seven hundred thirty-seven-kilometers radius. Massive, yet no atmosphere, wind, or weather. A frozen, airless world.
visual_goal: Moon cross-section showing layers, silent airless void.

title: The Fragile Link
narration: After nineteen sixty-nine, we returned just a handful of times. Six Apollo missions, twelve astronauts, all before nineteen seventy-two. And then, silence. The Moon has not heard a human voice since.
visual_goal: Continuation of story about lunar return missions.

title: Epilogue: Silence Endures
narration: The Moon remains silent, holding secrets of Earth's past and our future. Its silence speaks volumes. Maybe one day, we will answer it.
visual_goal: Moon in stillness, Earth rising in background, starfield.
